purpose: Attribution and tested sidecar interoperability snapshots; not a package dependency lockfile.

sources.name: Totoro Sunrun
sources.referenceRole: Optional local HTTP sidecar. Longmao delegates login validation, tasks, preview, run generation, start and queue/job logic to Totoro's existing APIs; no Totoro source is copied or vendored.

sources.name: WMPFDebugger
sources.licenseStatus: GPLv2 per upstream README and LICENSE; third-party code must be reviewed separately
sources.referenceRole: Optional local CDP sidecar. Longmao connects to WMPFDebugger's loopback CDP proxy as an external client; no hook, Frida, protobuf, source or binary is vendored.
